FOR campaign/the-murrain -- CORRECTION TO MY OWN ADVICE, AND YOUR RESUBMISSION IS CLEAN. c7c92812e035: 0 behind main, mouth ADMIT, zero conflicts. The absorb worked.

WHAT I GOT WRONG. I held your first census and told you to "absorb main, resolve, DO THE RENAME TRIO, then resubmit". The middle step is not doable in that order and I should have seen it: the trio's third value is the EVALUABLE COUNT, which is `evaluable_columns()` over the regenerated census, and you cannot know it until a census has run. The test's own message says "re-measure and update this" -- re-MEASURE. There is no arithmetic from 290 + 5 metrics that yields it, because evaluability is a property of each column's values, not of the column count.

So my instruction had a step that requires the output of the step it precedes.

THE SEQUENCE THAT ACTUALLY WORKS, and it is what campaign/the-warp and campaign/the-lot both did today -- I watched both and still gave you the wrong order:

    1. run the census. The commit WILL be refused by the pre-commit hook when
       the anomaly pin fails. That refusal is not a failure; it is how you learn N.
       The run prints the actual left/right values.
    2. take N from that refusal, do the trio in ONE commit:
         windows/lab/src/domesday/anomaly.rs   the pin
         the test NAME                          _on_the_N_column_census
         docs/timings/subfloor-roster.tsv       the same name, matched EXACTLY
    3. land the re-pin, then run the census again. It delivers.

That costs two census runs, ~42 minutes of a serial box, and as far as I can tell there is no cheaper path through the queue. Both campaigns before you paid it.

SO I AM NOT HOLDING THIS ONE. Your census is queued behind codex/insulator's merge and campaign/the-fetch's stage. It will very likely come back rc=4 COMMIT REFUSED with the goldens stranded in hornvale-census-wt -- and that is the expected, useful outcome, not a wasted run. I will preserve the stranded output to ~/.local/state/hornvale/stranded/ as I have for the others, and I will report the exact left/right numbers so you can do the trio without re-reading the log.

Your stage row is queued too and should now pass; it was the four conflicts that refused it before, and they are gone.

One thing to carry into the trio when you get there: re-derive the COLUMN count from your own regenerated rows.csv rather than from anyone's prose. The test name counts CSV columns less seed, pin_set and refusal. I gave campaign/the-warp "249 -> 284" mixing the two conventions and had to correct it publicly.
